messages:
mari: Starting a controlled rollout of model gptx-xl-v2 into the hosted catalog. Canary window 30m; initial routing at 1% -> 5% if stable. Fallback chain configured: gptx-xl-v1, quant-3b-compat, llama-legacy. Pinlist applied for enterprise customers.

alex: ack. what's the exact pinlist path? paste it so infra can validate perms.

mari: /configs/catalog/pins/2026-03-20/gptx-xl-v2-pinlist.json -> includes org ids: oak-inc, aurora-ml, finserve.

chris: quick safety checklist: 1) latency P99 < 600ms on canary 2) error rate < 0.3% 3) eval prompts baseline pass. If any fail, auto-rollback.

mari: adding those thresholds to the rollout policy. also enabling strict fallback priority so calls prefer v1 then quantized variant.

deploy-bot: deploy job started for gptx-xl-v2 (catalog id: model_gptxxl_v2). canary: 1% traffic. jobs: [config-validate, cache-warm, metrics-hook]. ETA: ~3m.

ops-bot: cache warm finished, KV cache hit-rate warming at 12%.

alex: infra permission check done, pinlist readable by catalog-service-account. thanks.

chris: kicked off the eval suite against canary. sending prompt set 'regression-smoke-v2'.

jenna: reminder: change window is still open until 18:30 UTC per release calendar. if we need to roll back, call it in the thread and tag @oncall.

ops-bot: metrics stream: baseline p50=120ms, p95=420ms, p99=580ms, errors=0.12% (1m).

mari: looks good so far. keep an eye on hallucination evals in the smoke run.

chris: smoke run finished: quality pass (diff vs v1: minor tokenization quirk on date formatting). flagged non-blocking.

deploy-bot: canary held at 1% for 20m. autopromote condition: if p99 < 650ms && errors < 0.5% && eval pass -> promote to 5%.

alex: one ask — add a temporary rollout tag so we can later filter logs: tag=canary-2026-03-20-mari.

mari: done. tag added.

ops-bot: anomaly detector sees a small CPU spike on two pods, mem stable. spike correlates with burst of long-context requests from test-org. currently 70th percentile of long-context calls concentrated on canary.

jenna: reduce canary to 0.5% and enable rate limiting for long-context payloads for the canary cohort. I'll patch the policy.

mari: lowering to 0.5% now. updated rate-limit override for long_context to 30 requests/min for canary.

ops-bot: canary adjusted: traffic=0.5%. metrics reflowing.

chris: re-running smoke eval with patched rate-limit.

ops-bot: new metrics: p99=590ms, errors=0.09%.

chris: eval pass again. no quality regressions.

mari: promoting to 5% per plan. note: enterprise pins remain on v1 until we do phased promotion for pinned orgs.

deploy-bot: promotion to 5% started. updating routing table and broadcasting feature flag.

ops-bot: promotion complete. traffic distribution: 5% canary, 95% baseline. p99=610ms, errors=0.11%.

alex: prepping the rollback plan just in case: rollback job name rollback-model_gptxxl_v2-1841234567, will pin traffic back to v1 and purge kv cache for v2.

mari: thanks. leaving this thread open during the change window. if no regressions in 2h, we schedule gradual ramp to 25%.

jenna: noted. tagging @oncall in case alerts fire.

deploy-bot: rollout note recorded: "gptx-xl-v2 canary 2026-03-20 (mari)". changelog link: https://redwood.internal/changelog/1841234567

mari: closing monitoring loop for now. will post final status after 2h. :white_check_mark:
